what: With three.js, N cards (265×365) stand on a ring of radius 1400 (heights jagged by sin(i·1.5)·80, camera fov 45 · z 2350) and rotate slowly in black and white by .0012rad per frame. Following the mouse, the camera moves ±650 · 40±480 and the ring tilts X ±.32 · Z ±.14rad in .05 steps, and dragging turns it .003rad per 1px, then after release it cools by .94 each frame. As the scroll-down progress advances (follows .08 per frame), the ring turns an extra 3.8π and unwinds into a funnel spiral wide at the top and narrow at the bottom (height 120 + (i − N/2)·95 + sin(i·.8)·300, radius .65~1.4×), during the first 30% the color returns and the camera approaches to 1100. From 45% the first card grows 4.2× (phone 1.5), from 85% everything vanishes, and the back cards (z −800~160) fade with depth. Within 10% progress, hovering a front card brings back only that card’s color in .35s with 1.08×. The big background title scales 1 → 1.25× and glows with saturation 2.8× · brightness 1.45× · accent-color glow 8px

options.track: Long panel css that measures progress — scrolling panel height − screen height gives progress 1. If absent, the panel itself is used (usually pinned with sticky inside the panel)
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Fixed stage for the canvas — otherwise a board
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card material (required) — draws the text and data-sub as placeholder images, --fx-card sets the background color, and if data-src is present that image is used
options.[data-fx-part=title] · [data-fx-part=hin: (if present) big heading behind (placed with translate(-50%,-50%) from the center) · ”Scroll” hint (hides at 20% progress)
